notes.title: Version 1.5
notes.content: We've enabled web services on the Windows build of the Puzzle Factory. This will enable future puzzle updates along with recommended Spacefarer software.

notes.title: Version 1.4
notes.content:
We are pleased to add the final game to The Puzzle Factory with this patch, Classic Mahjong with lots of modes and play styles. With relaxing music and animated graphics, this will keep you entertained for hours!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43724331/d87a08c3ecd87205b7b15e48b3ac3d6f71b3a1ea.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:
We've now added Solitaire to the Puzzle Factory! With leaderboards and excellent replay value!
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43724331/be56d1fe5c2f064e58a44254efc9ef2ccdab3fa5.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
-Excellent news! We've now added Spacefarer Chess to the Puzzle Factory in this update. Play an amazing game of chess against clever AI with beautiful presentation! For both WIndows and SteamOS / LInux.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43724331/47f586f1ad48842cc3cdc4f9821a2499469c3bd7.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
-Added controller support for maths game
-Fixed bugs
-Added exit button to maths game
-Added support for Steam Deck and Linux
